parameters.query:
-- Best scored jobs, respecting the daily review limit (10 per day).
-- MIN_SCORE: change 70 if you want more or fewer jobs.
WITH done_today AS (
  SELECT count(*) AS n
  FROM job_events
  WHERE new_status = 'tailored'
    AND changed_at >= (date_trunc('day', now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Bogota') AT TIME ZONE 'America/Bogota')
)
SELECT id, title, company, location, description, language
FROM jobs
WHERE status = 'scored'
  AND match_score >= 70
  AND (score_confidence = 'full' OR enrich_attempted)
ORDER BY match_score DESC, found_at DESC
LIMIT (SELECT greatest(0, 10 - n) FROM done_today);

UPDATE jobs
SET status = 'tailored', cv_file_name = $1, cover_letter = $2, tailored_cv = $3::jsonb
WHERE id = $4::bigint AND status = 'scored'
RETURNING id, title, company, cv_file_name;
